title: My Best Day at School
description: Practise school words and past simple, and write about your best day at school.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write about your best day at school in Part 2.

exercises.text: 🔬 In ___ lessons we learn about plants and animals.
exercises.explanation: Science is about plants, animals and how things work.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: Yesterday ___ my best day at school. (be)
exercises.explanation: Use "was" with one thing in the past.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: The teacher read us a story.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We singed a song in music class.
answers: We sang a song in music class.

exercises.text: 🎨 Art is ___ than maths for me.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: Our class ___ the quiz and got a prize! (win)

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: After "didn't" use the base verb: have.

exercises.text: It was the ___ day of the year.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: I ___ a long story in English class. (write)

exercises.explanation: Use "Did" to ask about the past.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Time + subject + verb: After lunch we sang.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Mai answered the question very good.
answers: Mai answered the question very well.

exercises.text: My teacher gave a prize ___ me.

task.prompt: Write about your best day at school.
contentPoints: Say what you did in class.
Say what you did at break.
Say why it was your best day.
usefulLanguage: My best day at school was ...
It was my best day because ...
task.modelAnswer: My best day at school was last Friday. In the morning we sang songs in music class. At break I played football with Minh. In the afternoon our teacher read us a funny story. It was my best day because we had fun.
